en.tagline: Free open-source app to enlarge images
en.description: Upscayl is a free app for Windows, Mac and Linux. It enlarges images with AI on your own computer. So your photos do not go to the internet. The software is open source.
bestFor: Enlarging photos for free and privately
limitations: Works best with a suitable graphics card
